title: fix(approvals): the approval request page names the record it decides on, Approve leads the band, one time face
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu5xKbCuyXQ5nYfei9GkjzN3)_

Fixes #35415

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgW5RH2VUXjRj9dZYH2

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The widening: `@object-ui/components` takes one optional member, `RecordHeaderState.title`, and exports its type `RecordHeaderTitle`. Nothing is removed or renamed.

## 维护者速读

- 审批请求页的标题从流程名（「费用报告签批」）换成审批人要看的业务记录名（「EXP-2001」），点标题就打开那条记录。只有页面自己读得到那条记录时标题才是链接；无权读、读不到、或平台标记已删除时，标题只显示名字、不能点，和同页「提交时的内容」卡片的规则一致。取不到记录名时仍显示流程名，标题里不会出现裸记录 id。
- 流程名只在标题下方高亮条的「流程」一格出现一次。卡片第 1 条写了「副标题写流程名」，这里没有加副标题：那一格已经紧贴在标题下方，再加副标题就是卡片抱怨的重复。
- 审批条里「通过」仍是实心主按钮，「驳回」改为描边加危险色文字，「通过」成为页面上最醒目的按钮。业务记录页上的审批条是同一个组件，也一起变。
- 审批动态里的时间改成和页头一样的写法（`2026/11/21 上午10:09`），不再带秒。
- 列表、搜索、最近访问和面包屑里，审批请求仍按流程名称呼，对象定义不变。只改前端显示，可以整体撤回。

## What changes

Card #35415 lists four defects on the approval request page. Read against main `fe753492`, two still held, one held in part, and one was already fixed:

| Card item | On main | This PR |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 1. The title is the flow's name; the record cannot be opened from it | held | the title names the record and links to it |
| 2. "As submitted" truncates text fields | fixed by #34588 (the record is drawn whole, values wrap) | nothing to do; the screenshots confirm |
| 3. Approve looks weaker than Reject | half: Approve was already filled, Reject was filled red | Reject becomes a destructive outline |
| 4. Two time formats on one page | held | the timeline uses the page's one face |

- **The page title (`RecordDetailView`, new `approval-decision/approvalSubjectTitle.tsx`).** On a `sys_approval_request` page the header names the business record by the `record_title` the approvals get already serves for it, as a link through the page's own record route (`RelatedRecordActionsBridge`'s `recordHref` / `openRecord`, the route the "As submitted" card's "Open record" link takes). A plain click opens the record the way the page opens one, which is the record drawer one level down on a desktop record page; a modifier or middle click keeps the anchor's new-tab behaviour. The name is a link only once one of the page's own reads of the record returned it, the rule the card's link follows (objectui#12557, objectui#11878): `SubmittedRecord`'s current read and `RecordPreviewCard`'s read report what they found through the new `RecordReadReportContext` (`approval-decision/recordReadReport.ts`), which `RecordDetailView` provides on a request page only. The title makes no read of its own. A refused, unresolvable or platform-deleted subject is named as plain text. Where the get serves no `record_title`, or one equal to the bare `record_id`, the header keeps the request's own title (`process_label`), so the page never names its subject by a raw id. That is the guarantee #24665 / PR #24708 gave the H1, kept here.
- **`RecordHeaderState.title` (`@object-ui/components`).** The host hands `{ text, node? }`, and `page:header` draws `node` (else `text`) in its H1 in both faces: in the host's top bar and in its own row (phone, and pages with no bar). Absent, or with an empty `text`, every title rung the header had is unchanged. It sits beside the state's existing `tags`, `group` and `stage`.
- **No subtitle.** The strip directly under the title already names the flow in its Flow chip, so the flow is named once. The card's item 1 asked for the flow as a subtitle. Adding one would put back the duplicate the card's first bullet complains about, so this PR does not add it. This reading is the one the claim (comment 7060828003, scope item 2) records.
- **The decision band (`DeclaredActionsBar`).** In the approver's band (`foldDecisions`, drawn by the request page's panel and by the business record page's band), a declared `danger` decision is drawn as an outline button in the destructive text colour. That is the face the record header's group already gives a secondary danger lever (#35593), and the two now share one condition (`secondaryDanger`). Approve keeps the filled primary face. A bar that does not fold keeps the declared filled danger face, and overrides keep their amber face.
- **One time face (`ApprovalActionTimeline`).** Action times render through core's `formatDateTime(…, { style: 'compact' })`, the face every `datetime` cell and the strip's `updated_at` chip draw, in the host's display time zone. They used to be the browser's `toLocaleString` (seconds, a 24-hour clock under zh-CN). The timeline on a business record page's approvals panel is the same component, so it changes too.
- `plugin-approvals`: comments only, in `sys-approval-request.object.ts` and `sys-approval-request.page.ts`, saying where the request page now names its record. The object's `nameField`, `highlightFields` and the page metadata are unchanged.

Not changed, per the card's "不做的": the structure of the progress and timeline cards.

## Why

An approver opens a request to decide on a business record. The page was titled by the process, which the strip repeated, and the record it is about had no name in the header and no link from it. The reject button outweighed approve, and the page wrote one moment in two ways.

## Verification

Tests added (each run red with its fix ablated, green with it):
- `approvalSubjectTitle.test.tsx` (new): read by the page, the title links through the host route; not read, plain text; a host that routes nowhere, plain text; a plain click is the host's `openRecord`, a modifier click the browser's; no title or an id-only title keeps the page's own. Ablating the read gate reds the not-read case.
- Served request page (console, real adapter stack): `servedPageRecordLink-12557` gains an H1 case (the H1 reads the subject and its plain click opens the same drawer, the page stays put) and the readable case now counts the card's link and the H1's; its refused CONTROL also checks the H1 is plain `INV-2020`. `servedPageReferenceStates-12489`: readable names and links the H1; deleted names it as plain `INV-3030`. `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484`: the served page is recognised by the subject's title in its H1. Ablating the read gate reds the refused CONTROL; ablating the report provider reds the two H1-link cases.
- `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx`, block `RecordDetailView.approvalSubjectTitle-35415` (real `RecordDetailView`, real `page:header`, desktop top bar): the H1 reads the served subject title, and with no reader of the subject on that page it links nowhere and reads nothing; no `record_title` keeps the flow label with no link; a `record_title` equal to the record id keeps the flow label and never prints the id; CONTROL: another object with the same fields keeps its own title. Ablating the host wiring reds the subject case only.
- `page-header-record-bar-35593.test.tsx`, block `the record state's title (objectstack#35415)`: the host's node is drawn inside the H1 in the bar and in the row; text-only; CONTROL: an empty title leaves the record's own name. Ablating the renderer reds the three host cases.
- `DeclaredActionsBar.approverFold-34361.test.tsx`, block `…leads with a filled Approve, Reject outlined (objectstack#35415)`: Approve `bg-primary`, Reject outline with `text-destructive` and no `bg-destructive`; CONTROL: a bar that does not fold keeps `bg-destructive`.
- `RecordApprovalsPanel.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx`: the de-DE and en pins now read the compact face (`4.3.2020 3:30 pm`, `3/4/2020 3:30 pm`), and a new zh-CN pin equals `formatDateTime(…, { style: 'compact' })` with no seconds. The three "is a reading of the session" pins are unchanged and green.

Local runs on this head (`88775b7e`, main `493ad095` merged in, so #35983's two-row record header is in):
- vitest, `ui/` root, on this head: every ui test file that names an approval request, `DeclaredActionsBar`, `ApprovalActionTimeline`, `RecordHeaderState`, `RecordPreviewCard`, `SubmittedRecord`, the record pointer card, `RecordDetailView`, `ApprovalDecisionPanel` or `page:header` (490 files, console included): `Test Files 490 passed`, `Tests 6483 passed`. The first CI run on `9097b572` was red in three console served-page files (16 tests); this commit is the fix, above.
- `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, on this head: 0 `error TS`.
- `eslint` over the changed files: 0 errors.
- `overlap-check.mjs` on this head: clean against origin/main `493ad095`, #36105 and #35923.

Browser (showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, console `vite`, zh-CN, the seeded pending request on `EXP-2001`, opened as its approver through `/system/approvals?request=`), before and after at 1280 and 375, light and dark, in the project thread's evidence folder:
- before: H1 `费用报告签批`, no link; Reject `bg-destructive`; timeline `2026/11/21 10:09:5x`.
- after (shot on `a02cb373`, where the subject reads, so the gate added since draws the same page; with #35983's two-row header: the crumb row reads 审批请求, the title row reads the record): H1 `EXP-2001`, linked to `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_expense_report/record/…`; a click opens `EXP-2001` in the record drawer; Approve filled, Reject outlined; timeline `2026/11/21 下午1:37`, the same face as the strip's `更新时间` chip.

## Acceptance notes

- Read first, by risk: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (`hostTitle` / `chipTitle`, both faces), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/approvalSubjectTitle.tsx` and `recordReadReport.ts` (the link's read gate), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` (`secondaryDanger`).
- Two-minute check: open a pending approval from the approvals inbox. The top bar reads the record's name, not the flow's. Click it and the record opens. In the band, 通过 is filled and 驳回 is outlined in red. The 审批动态 time reads like the strip's 更新时间.
- The subject link follows the page's record route, so it exists exactly where the "As submitted" card's "Open record" link does: a subject object the console can route to. Where it cannot, the title is the record's name as plain text.
- Breadcrumb, recent items and favourites still name a request by its own title (the flow), as lists and search do. Only the request page's header names the subject.
- Observed, not changed: at 375 px the strip's `更新时间` value is cut (`上午10:…`) in a half-width cell. That is the strip's layout, outside this card.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
